Market today: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are driving oil prices higher, while US Treasury yields are pushing towards 5% ahead of the Fed decision. This creates a risk-off environment, which is generally tough for your concentrated, margin-leveraged tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.13%) and SPAL (-30.89%) are deep in the red and leveraged, demanding immediate attention. QQQI (-3.28%) is also flagged for a trim. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on oil price movements and any further escalation in the Middle East, alongside the Fed's stance on interest rates and their impact on bond yields.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged positions and be highly selective on new tech buys given macro headwinds.
plays: SOXL: Your -52.13% loss on this leveraged ETF is significant. Seriously consider respecting your 200 stop or re-evaluating your position size.
SPAL: This leveraged ETF is down -30.89%. Review your 21.38 stop and consider if the risk is still acceptable.
QQQI: With a "TRIM" status and -3.28% loss, consider reducing your exposure to this income anchor to free up capital or reduce overall portfolio risk.
